items.summary: On March 11, 2019, the Administrator of the World Trade Center (WTC) Health Program received a petition (Petition 022) to add "monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (MGUS)" to the List of WTC-Related Health Conditions (List). Upon reviewing the scientific and medical literature, including information provided by the petitioner, the Administrator has determined that the available evidence does not have the potential to provide a basis for a decision on whether to add MGUS to the List.
